# Amariya

> An AI receptionist that answers every call 24/7 in 30+ languages, books into your system and hands off to your team. Live in 7 days or your money back.

Amariya is an AI voice receptionist by Legit Design Studio (https://www.legitdesign.studio). She tells callers she is an AI in her first sentence, answers in 30+ languages, books into the business's own system and hands calls or summaries to staff.

## Pages

- [Amariya](https://amariya.legitdesign.studio/): overview, pricing and questions for all niches
- [AI receptionist for hotels and restaurants](https://amariya.legitdesign.studio/hotels): Answers every guest call in their language, day and night, books rooms and tables into your system and hands VIPs to your desk. Live in 7 days.
- [AI receptionist for clinics and med spas](https://amariya.legitdesign.studio/clinics): Books consultations, takes deposits and passes anything clinical to your team, day and night, in your patients’ language. Live in 7 days.
- [AI receptionist for dental practices](https://amariya.legitdesign.studio/dental): Answers every patient call, books check-ups and urgent visits and moves appointments, in your patients’ language. Live in 7 days or a full refund.
- [Privacy](https://amariya.legitdesign.studio/privacy)

## Pricing

- Founding licence, paid once, for the first 30 businesses in each niche: $2,500 hotels and restaurants, $3,500 clinics, $3,000 dental practices
- Monthly: Starter $299, Professional $799, Enterprise priced on a call
- Every plan has a one-time $500 setup fee, paid upfront
- Live in 7 days or a full refund, then 7 days to change your mind
